race.comment: MEDIA SPIN (1) accounted for a maiden field over 1320m at this track last start, finishing a long neck ahead of the nearest rival. Is lightly raced and has plenty of scope for improvement. Reunites with Zoe Hunt who was on board last start. Serious contender again with the confidence high. PROPER TWELVE (2) stepped up to the mile for the first time last start at Tamworth and after looking a winning chance halfway down the straight he boxed on but missed the placings. Likely to push forward and race on the pace. Best form puts him right in this. SHARE OUR SECRET (10) finished second over this trip at Gunnedah two back then just missed on a blanket finish at Newcastle. Drawn low and only needs to hold his form to be right there again. ARWA MISS (6) improved sharply last time out to score by a nose over 1400m at Bathurst three weeks ago. Nicely placed to play a pivotal role.
